Dunaivtsi New Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Khmelnytska oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. This is the newer of Dunaivtsi's two Jewish cemeteries, still operational today, serving the same community devastated during WWII, when approximately 12,000 Jews were murdered in the town, including more than 7,000 executed or buried alive in the Solonich forest — one of the largest death tolls documented in this collection. Its oldest preserved gravestone dates to the mid-19th century, predating the 1871–72 purchase of land for a Jewish cemetery referenced in the town's own records, suggesting earlier use of the site.
